Q8185.reason: Kelsen’s Pure Theory isolates legal science from religion, ethics, sociology, and history so law is described without moral or political evaluation.

Q8198.reason: The constitutive theory holds that recognition by other states creates international legal personality and thus determines statehood.

Q8201.reason: Positivism’s separation thesis denies any necessary link between law and morals, so treating them as inseparable is the least accurate description.
